L07.question: What observable condition should expose the central historical price-CSV entry under Mehr: always with explicit position choice, only without a configured provider/listing, or also after a failed/insufficient actual history request? Configured access does not prove usable history. Existing import requires a particular position and its identity/currency; no silent position or provider choice.
L07.interim: Keep existing per-position entry until clarified; do not invent a provider availability heuristic.
